rule: A trigger during a routine room-copy write schedules exactly one follow-up write.
A page change during a room-copy read stops that write.
An import waits for a routine room-copy write already in flight.
The room-copy write gate is checked again after reading metadata.
A failed room-copy operation leaves a write owed.
A higher room copy found at read-back is adopted rather than marked failed.
A failed room-copy read marks the room copy as failed.
An import does not remove a room copy of its own generation.
An import does not overwrite a room copy from a newer build.
A trigger during an import write schedules exactly one follow-up write.
A verified import clears the owed room-copy write.
Catch-up completion schedules a room-copy write when one is owed.
Demotion clears the owed room-copy write and its not-saved notice.
An import read-back is accepted only when it holds the written copy.
find: return check.ok && readBackHolds(written, check.value) ? readBack : null;

rule: An import adopts a higher room copy found at read-back.
A failed import copy sets the not-saved notice.
Stopping during an active write preserves the stopped lifecycle after it settles.
An import waits through every routine write that was queued before it.
Failed import cleanup refreshes status from the metadata after removing a lower copy.
